reviewSamples.author: Photo of Lauren Robinson
reviewSamples.text: We accidentally locked our dog in the car and found George after searching on Google. AAA quoted us an hour to arrive even in their priority setting, while George arrived with 15 minutes on a Saturday morning and got the car unlocked within 5 minutes. We’re so thankful for him!

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Scott Reid
reviewSamples.text: George showed up within an hour of contact on a Sunday evening and was able to get us into our home quickly. Despite attempting a few different methods, he had to remove our lock. He was very friendly and even volunteered to come back the next day to help us install the replacement.
